svg.title: GLP-1 vision-loss lawsuits rose from 29 to 247 in 2026
svg.desc: Vision-loss (NAION) lawsuits pending in federal MDL 3163 against GLP-1 makers, by JPML monthly report: 1/5/2026 29, 2/2/2026 37, 3/2/2026 54, 4/1/2026 73, 5/1/2026 86, 6/1/2026 110, 7/1/2026 146, 8/3/2026 200, 9/1/2026 216, 10/1/2026 247. The separate stomach-injury MDL 3094 had 4,025 pending on October 1, 2026.

svg.text: Vision-loss lawsuits: 29 in January, 247 by October
